purpose: Handbook page for the Procenten domain (from year 5).
details: Sections: the hundred-square, converting percent/fraction/decimal, percent of a number with the percent strip, discount and VAT, and the cheat sheet. It follows the fixed work method of the main handbook page. Tables per school year and the list of thinking errors and the cheat sheet are generated by docs/tools/handleiding.py between auto markers; the screenshots show the 0.19 menus.
summary: Describes percentages: colouring and reading the hundred-square, converting between percent, fraction and decimal, a percentage of a number with the strip, discount and VAT (and percentage increase/decrease in m1), with tables per year and the cheat sheet.
